newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eltech to set up property subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Eltech to set up property subsidiary.

text.p: Electronics manufacturing services firm Eltech Electronics Ltd said on Thursday it was setting up a property development subsidiary.
"The latest venture is in line with Eltech's plan to diversify into real estate development with the intention of developing it into another core business of the group," said an Eltech statement.
Setting up the property unit followed Eltech's successful tender for four adjoining 99-year lease land parcels worth Singapore $13.18 million on Wednesday, it said.
The sites are designated for the construction of 19 terraced houses which could be completed by mid-1999 once Eltech gets shareholder and stock exchange approval for its property diversification.
Electronics would remain the main business of the group, the statement said.
